heading: From systems design to production automation.

items.title: Multi-agent systems & autonomous orchestration
items.description: Agent workflows that survive contact with production — LLM orchestration, supervisor–worker routing, stateful PostgreSQL checkpointers, Qdrant vector retrieval, and human-in-the-loop checkpoints.

items.title: Go systems & CLI infrastructure
items.description: High-concurrency daemons, network collectors, and developer tooling — native Go CLI applications, OpenSSH config generators, Ed25519 cryptography, and OS credential vault integrations.

items.title: Real-time speech AI & media pipelines
items.description: Low-latency continuous audio and video workflows — Faster-Whisper streaming over WebSockets, automated video and reel synthesis (Remotion, FFmpeg), and OpenCV computer vision models.

items.title: Distributed Python backends & APIs
items.description: Maintainable, production-ready microservices that scale — FastAPI, Django, Django Ninja, Celery distributed task queues, async I/O, on PostgreSQL and Redis.
